I catch most voles. They are small, quick, and numerous. I hear them scurrying in the leaf litter, and I strike with my feet. Sometimes I get a shrew, or a mouse, or a young field vole. But voles are the most common. Their squeaks are the first sounds I hear at dusk.

I catch most voles. They are the most common in the meadow and the wood. I can hear them moving under the leaves, and I can smell them in the soil. I catch most voles. They are the smallest and most common, and they run through the meadow in the dark. I hear them under the leaves and pounce. Their squeaks are like little bells.
